title: Living as One Building a Healthy Marriage
description:
A healthy marriage is beautiful!

Marriage is designed to be the most special and intimate relationship you will have on earth.
This book has been prepared to help couples build a healthy marriage by:

- Providing a biblical foundation for marriage.
- Helping prepare couples for marriage.
- Providing ideas to build a healthy marriage.

If you’re preparing for marriage or are already married, then this book is for you! You can work through this book together with your fiancé, fiancée, husband, or wife.

It pleases God when marriages reflect Jesus’ relationship
